## Goal
- Finish evidence-based release readiness for verification lifecycle, deterministic Owner AI chat ordering, and APK landing-release consistency.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do not create another Render service or repository.
- Do not deploy old code or use “Deploy previous commit.”
- Do not guess deployment causes or change configuration without evidence.
- Do not expose, retrieve, or return secret values.
- Physical-device QA and owner release acceptance require owner action/device access.
- Owner-only production mutation endpoints require a valid bearer token and confirmation text.

## Progress
### Done
- Confirmed fresh production health evidence:
  - `https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returned `{"ok":true,"status":"healthy",...}`.
  - Live senior-developer runtime reports commit SHA `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21`.

- `bun test "__tests__/ivx-chat.test.ts" "__tests__/chat-canonical-order.test.ts"` passed.

  - `bun test backend/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts` passed 21 tests.
  - Worker has `VERIFY_STAGE_TIMEOUT_MS`, stale active-job expiry, cancellation, resume, durable ledger behavior, and explicit terminal outcomes.

  - `backend/api/ivx-payment-api.ts`

- Keep APK release validation automated across Expo config, Android `versionName`, and every landing APK/QR reference.
- Use the owner-gated deployment-control endpoint for CloudFront invalidation; do not bypass authorization or handle secrets.
